segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Welcome to demo day! Four teams are presenting. Let's start with search.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Thanks. We shipped typo-tolerant search. Watch, if I search "invioce", it still finds invoices.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: That's great. Does it handle multiple typos?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Up to two per word, and it ranks exact matches higher.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Next up, Marisol and the onboarding team.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: We rebuilt the first-run checklist. Activation in the beta cohort is up nine points.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: I want to call out Marisol's work here. She ran all the user interviews and rewrote the checklist copy herself, and it shows. Fantastic job.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Agreed, that was a really thoughtful project. Daniel, you're next.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: We added bulk editing to the admin console. You can select up to five hundred users and change roles at once.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: Yes, for ten minutes after the change.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Last one is the infra team, presented by Hiro.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: We moved the job queue to the new cluster with zero downtime. Queue latency dropped by about half.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: How did you test the cutover?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: We dual-wrote for a week and compared outputs before switching reads.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great demos, everyone. Recordings will be in the shared drive. Big thanks to all the teams.

notes: Hard negative: public praise of a teammate's work.
